name: Cyprus Department of Civil Aviation
notes: Role split verified: the DCA (mcw.gov.cy/mcw/dca) is responsible for the provision and regulation of air traffic services in the Nicosia FIR and the Larnaca and Paphos towers, so it fills both CAA and ANSP roles on this single entity (source once). The only logo located is the 'Civil Aviation Department Emblem' (alt text) in the header of its legacy Domino pages: a 100x57 GIF slice (topRight.gif, globe artwork on a blue gradient) served by mcw.gov.cy (tier 2, website-served; GIF support added to the validator for this). It is a low-resolution page-header image, not a published logo file. No brand page or terms located, so redistribution rights are not confirmed. The GIF has its transparency flag set but every pixel is opaque (transparency verified by inspecting the pixels with ImageMagick), so the record says transparent=false; validate.py accepts either value for a GIF whose flag is set.

gaps.need: high-resolution or vector logo, dark variant and guidelines
